title: How Much Does Social Media Management Cost in the UK? (2026 Prices)
meta_title: Social Media Management Cost UK (2026 Prices)
meta_description: UK social media management costs £300–£1,500 a month for most small businesses. Freelancer vs agency vs in-house vs monthly plan, with what each includes.
keywords: how much does social media management cost uk
social media management for small business uk

faq.q: How much does social media management cost per month in the UK?
faq.a: Most UK small businesses pay £300 to £1,500 a month, excluding ad spend. Freelancers charge £300–£1,000, agencies £1,250–£3,500 per channel, and monthly plans like the Social Fellow start from £59.

faq.q: Is £300 a month enough for social media management?
faq.a: Yes, for one to three platforms with regular posting and content you partly supply. It usually won't cover heavy video production, paid ads management or daily community replies.

faq.q: How much does a freelance social media manager charge in the UK?
faq.a: The average UK freelance social media day rate is about £334, or around £42 an hour. Monthly retainers for small businesses usually fall between £300 and £1,000.

faq.q: Does social media management include paid ads?
faq.a: Not usually. Ad spend is paid to the platform, and managing ads is often a separate fee. Always ask whether ads are included before comparing quotes.

faq.q: How many platforms should a small business be on?
faq.a: Two or three, chosen by where your customers spend time. Facebook and Instagram suit most local businesses, LinkedIn suits B2B, and TikTok suits younger audiences.

faq.q: Can I cancel a social media management contract?
faq.a: It depends on the provider. Many agencies ask for 3 to 12 months. ContentFellow bills monthly and you can change or remove your Fellow from the next month.
